description: This file appears to be a Perl module implementing the Git::SVN package, which provides integration and operations for managing Subversion repositories within a Git ecosystem. It includes functions for repository configuration, revision mapping, fetching, and metadata handling, suggesting it's a core component of a larger system that bridges Git and SVN.

classes.name: Git::SVN
classes.description: Main class providing methods to interact with SVN repositories within the Git context, including revision mapping, fetch operations, configuration, and metadata management.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Constructor for Git::SVN objects. Initializes Remote configuration based on URL, path, and repository identifiers.

methods.name: find_by_url
methods.description: Finds an existing Git::SVN object matching the provided URL, optionally considering repo root and path for precise matching.

methods.name: repos_root
methods.description: Retrieves the repository root URL associated with this SVN remote.

methods.name: full_url
methods.description: Returns the full canonical URL of the SVN repository including path.

methods.name: last_rev
methods.description: Returns the latest known revision number.

methods.name: last_commit
methods.description: Returns the latest commit SHA1 associated with the revision.

methods.name: last_rev_commit
methods.description: Returns a tuple of the newest revision number and commit SHA1, updating internal cached values as needed.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Fetches revisions within a specified range, updating the internal revision map.

methods.name: make_log_entry
methods.description: Constructs a detailed log entry for a specific revision, including metadata, authorship, merge info, and untracked changes.

methods.name: set_tree
methods.description: Sets the tree (state of the repository) for a specific revision, optionally applying a diff.

methods.name: rebuild
methods.description: Rebuilds internal revision maps from the revision database, useful for syncing states.

methods.name: rev_map_set
methods.description: Associates an SVN revision number with a Git commit SHA1 in persistent storage.

methods.name: rev_map_get
methods.description: Retrieves a Git commit SHA1 associated with an SVN revision number from persistent storage.
